item.title: R Commander Help.
item.description:
Hi guys! I really need some assistance, I'm following the instructions to find the "simultaneous tests for general linear hypotheses" and I've been told to do a one way anova to find this however my Rcmdr isn't giving me anything else, it's just giving this:
\> library(multcomp, pos=19)
\> AnovaModel.3 <- aov(Psyllids \~ Hostplant, data=psyllid)
\> summary(AnovaModel.3)
Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
Hostplant 2 602.3 301.17 15.18 0.000249 \*\*\*
Residuals 15 297.7 19.84
\---
Signif. codes: 0 '\*\*\*' 0.001 '\*\*' 0.01 '\*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
\> with(psyllid, numSummary(Psyllids, groups=Hostplant, statistics=c("mean", "sd")))
mean sd data:n
Citrus 27.83333 5.154286 6
Murraya 20.50000 4.722288 6
Rhododendron 13.66667 3.265986 6
\> local({
\+ .Pairs <- glht(AnovaModel.3, linfct = mcp(Hostplant = "Tukey"))
\+ print(summary(.Pairs)) # pairwise tests
\+ print(confint(.Pairs, level=0.95)) # confidence intervals
\+ print(cld(.Pairs, level=0.05)) # compact letter display
\+ old.oma <- par(oma=c(0, 5, 0, 0))
\+ plot(confint(.Pairs))
\+ par(old.oma)
\+ })
It's supposed to have letters or something but I'm trying to figure out why mines not giving the proper result. yes I have to use R commander not R studio. Thanks. :)
